editorial:
Imagine moving into a new home only to find out it comes with a scary secret. You follow Colin, a writer who used to be a priest, and his wife, Kayleigh. They are trying to start over, but Kayleigh's dead sister is not happy about it. The movie creates a creepy mood right away, making you feel like something is watching the couple from the shadows. It is not just about jump scares, but about the dark family secrets that start to come out as the ghost gets more aggressive. You will feel the tension build as Colin tries to use his old faith to stop the supernatural attacks.

The acting is solid and makes the fear feel real. While the middle part of the movie slows down a bit, the ending really picks up the pace with some shocking turns. If you like ghost stories that focus on family trauma, you will love this. To get the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video so you can see every detail of the scares. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call for a rainy night.
endingExplained: You find out that the sister was not just a random ghost. She was killed in a terrible way, and her spirit wants revenge on those who hurt her. Colin tries to perform an exorcism to save Kayleigh, but it turns out the evil is deeper than they thought. The movie ends with a twist showing that the cycle of violence continues, leaving you wondering if anyone truly escaped the curse of the house.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves paranormal mysteries and spooky house movies.
